data.description: Luxury 3BR Duplex+Maid | Full Sea and Marina View
data.long_description:
Experience elevated waterfront living in this exceptional fully furnished 3-bedroom duplex apartment in Cayan Tower, Dubai Marina’s iconic twisting architectural masterpiece. Spanning two levels, this spacious residence combines villa-style privacy with luxury tower living.

The apartment features bright open-plan living and dining areas with floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing stunning full sea and Marina views. Newly upgraded and tastefully remodeled, the home offers modern finishes and refined interiors throughout.

A standout feature is the dedicated family room with a villa-style pantry, creating an additional private space ideal for relaxing, entertaining, or working from home. The modern kitchen includes premium cabinetry, high-quality appliances, sleek finishes, and a stylish kitchen island for casual dining.

All bedrooms are generously sized with built-in wardrobes, while the maid’s room adds extra convenience. The en-suite bathrooms feature two standalone bathtubs positioned against spectacular Marina and sea views, creating a true luxury retreat. Two private balconies complete the home, offering beautiful outdoor living spaces.

Property Features:
• 3-bedroom duplex
• Maid’s room
• Additional family room
• Villa-style pantry area
• 2 private balconies
• Fully furnished
• High-floor unit
• Kitchen island
• 2 standalone bathtubs with Marina & sea views
• Floor-to-ceiling windows
• Spacious open-plan layout
• Built-in wardrobes
• Premium finishes throughout

Residents enjoy world-class amenities including an infinity pool, state-of-the-art gym, spa, sauna, steam rooms, cafés, mini mart, salons, children’s play area, 24/7 concierge, covered parking, and direct access to Marina Walk. Ideally located within walking distance to the beach, tram, restaurants, cafés, and retail outlets.
